form.title: Investment Interest Expense Deduction

lines.caption: Investment interest expense paid or accrued in 2025 (see instructions)
Disallowed investment interest expense from 2024 Form 4952, line 7
Total investment interest expense. Add lines 1 and 2
Gross income from property held for investment (excluding any net gain from the disposition of property held for investment)
Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment
Enter the smaller of line 4d or your net capital gain from the disposition of property held for investment. See instructions
Enter the amount from lines 4b and 4e that you elect to include in investment income. See instructions
Net investment income. Subtract line 5 from line 4h. If zero or less, enter -0-

Investment interest expense deduction. Enter the smaller of line 3 or line 6. See instructions

form.notes: Declared for spec 080 T052: the investment interest limitation is a computation (investment-interest-deduction). The sheet places the interest as printed on Schedule A line 9 and lists the Form 4952 inputs beside it; it never applies the line 8 limit. Line 2 needs last year's Form 4952 line 7, which no declared document carries yet (Phase 8).
